findings.issue_text: ensure_loaded! is only invoked from ApplicationController#set_locale, so non-request code paths (Sidekiq jobs, mailers via I18n.with_locale, rake tasks) never load the site-default fallback locale into the lazy translate_accelerator backend, causing 'translation missing' instead of the intended fallback; the load should happen in the fallback path itself

FallbackLocaleList#[] calls SiteSetting.default_locale on every fallback lookup, including before the database is available (db:migrate on fresh DB, assets:precompile, boot-time initializers), introducing a DB dependency that can raise during bootstrap/deploy

FallbackLocaleList overrides Hash#[] to recompute [locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact on every call, defeating the Fallbacks backend's memoization and adding an array allocation plus SiteSetting read per translate call on hot paths

Fallbacks are now enabled in all environments including development and test (previously production/profile-only), so specs asserting on missing-translation behavior will silently pass by falling through to :en

ensure_loaded! in translate_accelerator.rb does an unsynchronized check-then-load on @loaded_locales, so concurrent threads can both run load_locale, duplicating file parsing and racing on the backend's translations hash

config/initializers/i18n.rb calls I18n.ensure_loaded! but the method is defined on the backend (I18n.backend), not the I18n module, which would raise NoMethodError on the first request unless delegated
No specs cover the new fallback chain (user locale → site default → :en), the uniq/compact behavior when user locale equals site default, or that the fallback locale is actually loaded before lookup

The '# order: after 02-freedom_patches.rb' comment is informational only; initializer ordering relies on alphabetical filename coincidence, and renaming the file could cause the I18n.backend.class include to run before the accelerator patch; an explicit require_dependency or numbered filename is needed

goldens.comment: The @loaded_locales instance variable in translate_accelerator.rb is lazily initialized and accessed by multiple concurrent threads without synchronization.

Consider normalizing the input locale (e.g., to a symbol) when checking/loading here to avoid double-loading if the same locale is passed as a String vs Symbol (also applies to other locations in the PR).

adjudication_records.issue_text: ensure_loaded! is only invoked from ApplicationController#set_locale, so non-request code paths (Sidekiq jobs, mailers via I18n.with_locale, rake tasks) never load the site-default fallback locale into the lazy translate_accelerator backend, causing 'translation missing' instead of the intended fallback; the load should happen in the fallback path itself

FallbackLocaleList#[] calls SiteSetting.default_locale on every fallback lookup, including before the database is available (db:migrate on fresh DB, assets:precompile, boot-time initializers), introducing a DB dependency that can raise during bootstrap/deploy

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a custom `I18n.fallbacks` object whose `FallbackLocaleList#[]` method always calls `SiteSetting.default_locale`. That means *any* codepath that triggers I18n fallback resolution (not just web requests) can now indirectly require `SiteSetting`, which in typical Rails apps (and especially Discourse-like setups) is backed by the database. This is a real behavioral change from the previous `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` (which falls back to `I18n.default_locale` without consulting app settings/DB), and it can cause failures in bootstrap contexts where the DB isn’t ready/available but translations/fallbacks are used (e.g., asset precompile, early initialization, fresh migrate).

adjudication_records.issue_text: FallbackLocaleList overrides Hash#[] to recompute [locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact on every call, defeating the Fallbacks backend's memoization and adding an array allocation plus SiteSetting read per translate call on hot paths

adjudication.rationale: In config/initializers/i18n.rb, FallbackLocaleList subclasses Hash but overrides `[]` to always return a freshly built array `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact` without storing it in the Hash. Since I18n fallbacks code calls `I18n.fallbacks[locale]` during lookups, this removes the usual caching/memoization behavior you’d get from using a Hash-backed fallbacks map (or I18n’s own fallback implementation) and introduces per-call allocations plus a `SiteSetting.default_locale` read on the translation path.

adjudication_records.issue_text: Fallbacks are now enabled in all environments including development and test (previously production/profile-only), so specs asserting on missing-translation behavior will silently pass by falling through to :en

adjudication.rationale: The diff removes `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` from production/profile, but adds a new global initializer `config/initializers/i18n.rb` that `include`s `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` and sets `I18n.fallbacks = FallbackLocaleList.new` unconditionally. Initializers run in all environments (including development and test), so fallbacks are now enabled everywhere. This can change missing-translation behavior in tests by allowing lookups to fall back to `SiteSetting.default_locale` and then `:en` instead of producing a missing translation.

adjudication_records.issue_text: config/initializers/i18n.rb calls I18n.ensure_loaded! but the method is defined on the backend (I18n.backend), not the I18n module, which would raise NoMethodError on the first request unless delegated

adjudication.rationale: In the new initializer `config/initializers/i18n.rb`, `FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded!` calls `I18n.ensure_loaded!(l)`. In this diff, the only `ensure_loaded!` method added is `def ensure_loaded!(locale)` inside `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb`, which is an instance method intended for the backend (i.e., `I18n.backend.ensure_loaded!`). There is no definition or delegation shown that adds `ensure_loaded!` to the `I18n` module itself, so `I18n.ensure_loaded!` would raise `NoMethodError` when `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` is invoked (now called from `ApplicationController#set_locale`).

adjudication_records.issue_text: No specs cover the new fallback chain (user locale → site default → :en), the uniq/compact behavior when user locale equals site default, or that the fallback locale is actually loaded before lookup

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes I18n fallback behavior and loading, but it does not include or reference the test suite. The proposed finding asserts absence of specs covering the new fallback chain and load-before-lookup behavior, which cannot be verified from this diff alone and is not itself a concrete defect in the implementation shown. Therefore it’s speculative rather than a verifiable problem introduced by the diff.

adjudication_records.issue_text: The '# order: after 02-freedom_patches.rb' comment is informational only; initializer ordering relies on alphabetical filename coincidence, and renaming the file could cause the I18n.backend.class include to run before the accelerator patch; an explicit require_dependency or numbered filename is needed

adjudication.rationale: The concern is about a hypothetical future rename. In the diff as shown, the initializer is named `config/initializers/i18n.rb`, and Rails runs initializers in alphabetical order, so it will naturally run after an initializer named `02-freedom_patches.rb` (as the comment indicates). There is no verifiable bug or correctness issue introduced by the diff itself; the finding is a maintainability/speculation note rather than a real defect present in this change.
